detailed_description: The PDF Compressor loads a PDF in your browser and saves a new copy with pdf-lib. You can choose a low, medium, or high setting; the high setting enables PDF object streams during saving, which may reduce file size for some documents. The result shows the original size, new size, and calculated reduction before you download the new PDF. This is useful for trying a quick browser-based rewrite of a PDF before sharing or archiving it. It does not downsample images, remove fonts, guarantee a smaller output, or preserve every advanced PDF feature in all documents.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and choose a PDF file from your device
Review the original file size shown after upload
Select Low, Medium, or High rewrite setting
Click Rewrite PDF to create a new saved copy in the browser
Compare the original and new sizes shown in the result
Download the new PDF if the output size is useful for your workflow
usage_examples: An office worker tries to reduce a PDF before attaching it to an email
A student checks whether a class handout can be saved as a smaller copy
A support agent rewrites a PDF manual and compares the new size before sharing
A small business owner prepares a lighter copy of a PDF invoice for upload
